attempts.summary: Built an IKEv2/IPsec site-to-site tunnel between OPNsense firewalls node1 and node2 over their shared transit link (10.99.99.0/30 on vtnet1), carrying the private networks lan-a (10.10.10.0/24, node3) and lan-b (10.20.20.0/24, node4) through a tunnel-mode child SA. node3 and node4 now reach each other by their private addresses, encrypted in transit (verified via ESP capture on the transit link showing no plaintext ICMP). All four nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory evidence protocol; boot-identity changes were confirmed and full service/tunnel/connectivity recovery verified after each restart.
